title: What Kitchen Organization Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of kitchen organization: what it is and why getting it right pays off.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Kitchen Organization
summary: Start kitchen organization this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Empty and declutter (duplicates, broken, unused)
2. Define zones around your workflow
3. Relocate items to their zones
4. Contain: bins, dividers, risers
5. Label pantry containers

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Kitchen Organization Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with kitchen organization — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Storing by category instead of workflow → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Deep cabinets without pull-outs → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Keeping broken or duplicate gadgets → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- No labels (the pantry rots) → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.
